aliases: What do you understand by 'clients with particular needs'?

one_line_answer.text: Clients with particular needs include people with disability; acknowledge, respect and value them.

cites.quote: It is also important to acknowledge, respect and value clients with particular needs,

bangla_explanation: কিছু clients-এর বিশেষ চাহিদা থাকে; তাদের আলাদা করে সম্মান ও support দিতে হয়।
তালিকায় পাঁচটা দল: women (where under represented), low literacy, disability, rural and remote, youth at risk।
শুধু 'women' লিখবেন না; লিখুন 'women where under represented'।
এদের জন্য physical environment adjustments, more time আর বাড়তি support লাগতে পারে।

example.en: A welding course has few women and some learners from remote char areas. The centre gives them more time and support.
example.bn: Welding course-এ নারী কম, আর কিছু learner চর এলাকা থেকে আসে; তাদের more time ও support দেওয়া হয়।

list_answer.title: Clients with particular needs
items_bn: যেখানে নারীদের অংশগ্রহণ কম (under represented), সেখানকার women — তাদের অংশ নিতে আলাদা উৎসাহ ও সহায়তা লাগে।
যারা পড়তে-লিখতে বা হিসাব করতে কম পারেন (low literacy, numeracy) — লেখা-পড়া নির্ভর কাজে তাদের বাড়তি সহায়তা লাগে।
প্রতিবন্ধিতা আছে এমন মানুষ (people with disability) — তাদের জন্য পরিবেশ ও পদ্ধতি মানিয়ে নিতে হতে পারে।
গ্রাম বা দূরবর্তী এলাকার learners (rural and remote) — দূরত্বের কারণে শেখার সুযোগ পাওয়া ও যোগাযোগ কঠিন হতে পারে।
ঝুঁকিতে থাকা তরুণ (youth at risk) — তাদের প্রতি বাড়তি মনোযোগ ও সহায়তা দরকার।

short.prompt: What do you understand by 'clients with particular needs'?
short.modelAnswer:
Clients with particular needs are clients we must acknowledge, respect and value. They include:
1. Women where under represented
2. People with low literacy, numeracy
3. People with disability
4. Rural and remote learners
5. Youth at risk
They may need physical environment adjustments, adjusted activities and more time or support.

keyPoints.text: It is important to acknowledge, respect and value clients with particular needs.

cites.quote: It is also important to acknowledge, respect and value clients with particular needs,

keyPoints.text: Support for special needs includes physical environment adjustments.
Support includes adjustments to learning and assessment activities.

mcq.prompt: Which group is listed as clients with particular needs?

matching.prompt: Complete each group of clients with particular needs.

viva.prompt: Name three clients with particular needs.

answer.text: People with disability, rural and remote learners, and youth at risk.

checks.note: Official paper MCQ 1 (p.1, key p.5) offers Women / Young / Man / Disability and keys 'Disability'. CBLM 2 p.7 also lists 'Women where under represented' and 'Youth at risk', so Women and Young are partly correct too. Card teaches the full CBLM list and shows the key as a trap. MCQ 1 itself cannot be mapped: its id is the same as Short 1 in the evidence.
